note: Story County Conservation, N of Zearing, on 20 acres of water in two lakes (electric trolling motors only; no swimming). Two campgrounds: the main loop with the shower house, and the east campground with its own entrance off 710th Ave. Main-loop sites overlook the lake across open grass but sit back from the waterline. --Claude
summary: Rates $23/$27 + $4 confirmed. Count 29->37 (29 main + 8 east, county); added 50-amp, showers, dump, min stays, 14-night limit, window, season Apr-Oct. Vault toilet cleared. Lakeview holds.
flags: WATERFRONT, stored lakeview holds; borderline in one direction. Esri at 42.1710,-93.2975: main loop's pads on the outside of the loop have no road between them and the water, across open unmown prairie. West side: about 40 m of grass to a marshy lake edge (mottled emergent vegetation, open water further); east side, about 50 m of meadow to the east lake. South side the park road passes between pads and the lake. So the outer west/east pads sit at about the ~50 m bound with a marshy shore: I read this as a view, not access. East campground (42.1700,-93.2908, map on the park page) pads about 50-80 m from the lake's south end with the youth-camping trees between: not on the water.
Not a split: east and main campgrounds have separate entrances (county map: 'East Entrance', 710th Ave) but pad centres are only about 370 m apart, under the ~1 km rule.
